# evidence_training_sample

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Transforms admitted episode evidence into a provenance-bound training sample while refusing evidence-free labels.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sample_id` | `string` | yes | Stable training sample identity. |
| `episode_id` | `string` | yes | Source learning episode identity. |
| `feature_digest` | `string` | yes | Digest of the decision-relevant feature projection. |
| `label_id` | `string` | yes | Outcome or failure label identity. |
| `provenance_digest` | `string` | yes | Immutable provenance proving how the sample was derived. |
